name: THE SOLKADI
description:
Authentic Malvani seafood & solkadi, served with homely love 🌊🐟

The Solkadi is a home-grown Malvani seafood khanaval that celebrates the rich flavors of Konkan. From spicy fish curries and crispy fried prawns to the refreshing tang of our signature solkadi, every dish is prepared with authentic recipes, fresh ingredients, and homely care.
We combine tradition, hygiene, and hospitality to bring you meals that feel both comforting and memorable. Whether you’re craving a wholesome thali or a quick seafood bite, The Solkadi serves the true taste of Malvan right here at home.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Kolambi Thali - Malwani style gravy with Jumbo Prawns,  Rice and Rice Bhakri/Chapati and Fried Prawns.
Bangada Thali - Goan Style gravy with Fresh of the Boat Mackerels, Rice Bhakri/Chapati and Fried Bangda.
Bombil Thali - Bombay Ducks so lucious, they fall off the bone, with Rice Bhakri/Chapati and Fried Bombils.
Surmai Fry - Huge 2 pieces of King Fish so succulent and tender, fried with Konkani style Masalas which you can't stop devouring.

*My Suggestion - Try the Rice Bhakri, they are to die for.*

P.S - The image doesn't do it Justice. But coming from a foodie, It's worth it all.
I'm definitely returning back here.

featured_reviews.name: vikrant mandiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
A not to miss type fish market in Naigaon.
You get a variety of see food here both in wholesale and retail. This is not a very big place but it here you will find all major seafoods fresh..direct from the fishing boats that sell their stuff right on the spot.

You will get pamplets fish, squids , lobsters, carbs, rawas, surmai, bangda...the list goes on...price wise you really have to bargain..here you will get the raw fish ..either you clean n cut yourself or get it done here only at a nominal fees.

Overall if you are seafood lover, you must visit this place someday.

featured_reviews.name: Nagesh Tambat
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of iconic fish market in Naigaon west (Palghar). The market starts at 8.30 pm in the evening and runs until 12 am in the midnight. Also, the market remains closed on Tuesday and Thursday.

Good place for all fish lovers. This place is ideal for buyers who want to buy fish in bulk. Two or Three families can buy the fish together and later on they can divide it so that you will good quantity at low price.

You need to have strong bargaining skills, because the ladies who sell fish will ask for high price and can agree to give even at less than half price which they have initially quoted. So, strong bargaining skills are must needed to buy fish in this market.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
A good place to  get fresh fishes at good prices.
A good place to buy bulk quantity of fish.
There are Auctions too for crate full of fishes..

Things to Keep in Mind Before you go.

1:- Wear.dull.shabby.clothes ( As you are going to be completely covered with fish smell + Sellers might  try to paste you with a hiked price by looking at your look)

2:-Master your bargaining skills before you go.

3:- Carry Container or ample.amount of bags

4:-  Don't Expect Online Payment (Gpay/Paytm /Phonepay or any ). Carry sufficient cash
5:- Keep Eeew Eeew  Feeling aside and go.

featured_reviews.name: SP Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: There's the usual selection of fish at wholesale prices. Although there's a wide variety  it is interesting to see... relatively reasonably priced if you are going to buy a ton of fish, full of small size stores selling fish, shrimp, crab, ...... it is a good opportunity to watch several types of fishes.

featured_reviews.name: PratikG. Naik
featured_reviews.review_text: Naigaon Fish Market is WholeSale fish market, where you will get varieties of fresh fishes just landed from fishing boats on same days in market. Please note that this market is only available at 10 pm to 2 pm, hence if you are planning to visit in day, you will get nothing special from here and u need to plan  your visit for night. I would recommend that you come with 4-5  people's and buy entire fish rack and distribute amongst all of u, due to this u will get fishes at low price with more quantities. You can drive bike or car here but due to huge customers vehicles at same time, you may face traffic or congestion. Another way of travelling is that u can use train hence Naigaon railway station is 10 minutes away by auto.

featured_reviews.name: Sanya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here’s something that sounds like your casual, slightly frustrated review style:

Went here for lunch and honestly, the experience was pretty disappointing.

First of all, the place was SO damn hot. For such a huge property (and I mean HUGE), I was surprised by how uncomfortable the seating was. The restaurant was quite empty, and there was a table available right next to a cooler fan. We politely asked if we could move there, but the staff was extremely hesitant for no reason. It took a lot of convincing, multiple requests, and quite a bit of waiting before they finally agreed.

What made it worse was how unprofessional and unhelpful the staff felt throughout the whole interaction. It shouldn’t be that difficult to accommodate a simple seating request, especially when the restaurant isn’t even crowded.

As for the food, it was pretty average and definitely didn’t make up for the experience. We also noticed a few hygiene issues, which was another letdown.

Overall, the service, comfort, and hygiene standards need serious improvement. Unfortunately, not an experience I’d be keen to repeat.

However when it comes to Food its quite good not best also they have very high menu price. Almost 20% more from others.
Jalebi - Rabdi is good in Desserts again its very costly.

Note - They do not have any Zomato/Dineout/EasyDinner offer.

Service is attentive and friendly, adding to the overall experience. Whether you’re craving traditional North Indian dishes or simply want a cozy place to relax, Kinara Dhaba delivers on all fronts. It’s a place where quality meets value, making every visit memorable and worth repeating. Highly recommended for anyone who loves hearty, flavorful meals.

featured_reviews.name: Sweta Tandel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I remember when this restaurant first opened; the food was truly authentic, packed with traditional flavors, and every dish felt like a careful, home-cooked labor of love. It was a local gem, and I recommended it to everyone. Unfortunately, based on our experience today, something fundamental in the kitchen has changed, and the taste is no longer the same.
​We visited today hoping for that original, rich experience, but were severely let down by both main components of our order.
​First, the bhakri we received was undoubtedly stale. It was tough, brittle, and tasted distinctly like it had been prepared yesterday and merely reheated.
​Second, the mutton gravy was the biggest disappointment in terms of flavor. The texture and profile felt altered, and upon closer inspection, it was clear why: the dish was bulked up with large amounts of capsicum (bell peppers). While capsicum is a great vegetable, it has absolutely no place in a traditional mutton preparation and completely overrides the authentic spices and meat flavor. This seems like a cost-cutting measure to increase the volume of the dish, but it has killed the signature taste that made this place great.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve visited your restaurant a couple of times before, but this is now the second time I’ve experienced extremely poor service and terrible food quality.I had ordered one guava and litchi flavored mocktail, garlic bread, chicken biryani, and chicken crispy. As always, I clearly told the server my preference for the order sequence — garlic bread, chicken crispy, and the mocktail to be served first. But instead, the waiter brought only the chicken crispy and then the biryani. The biryani was left lying at the counter for almost 10 minutes for no reason before being served.
Being from the hospitality industry myself, I was quite disappointed to see such carelessness.Then the mocktail arrived — completely mishandled. It came overloaded with chili powder, and no one bothered to inform or explain this beforehand. I have never tasted such an unpleasant mocktail in my life.Finally, while eating the biryani, I found a hair in the dish. I calmly informed the waiter, but he didn’t react at all — no apology, no concern, nothing. He just changed the plate and walked off as if nothing had happened. Completely unprofessional.
I’m writing this because people spend their hard-earned money to dine at your restaurant, and receiving such pathetic service and quality is unacceptable.
After this experience, I will never visit your restaurant again, nor will I recommend it to anyone I know.
Maybe one guest leaving won’t affect you much, but I truly hope you reflect on this and improve your service and standards.

featured_reviews.name: PRANITA CHAVAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited the newly opened restaurant Akshit today, and I must say — it was an amazing experience from start to finish!

🌱 Veg Dishes
🍽 Starters 🍽
• Hara Bhara Kebab – Really good, perfectly cooked and flavorful.

🍽 Main Course 🍽
• Veg Kolhapuri – Excellent! Full of authentic taste and spice.
• Paneer Hyderabadi Biryani – Superb. Just go for it. 100/100 without a doubt!

🍗 Non-Veg Dishes
🍽 Starters 🍽
• Hunan Chicken – Medium spicy and absolutely delicious. 101/100!
• Pahadi Chicken (Half) – Slightly on the creamy side but WOW. Excellent and totally loved it. Quantity is great. Half is enough for two people.
• Pomfret Tawa Fry – 10/10. Fresh, crispy and perfectly done.

🍽 Main Course 🍽
• Chicken Patiala – Comes in green gravy. It was decent, but not what we expected. Instead of regular chicken pieces in gravy, it had small chicken pieces stuffed inside an omelette, and the omelette was covered in green gravy. Interesting concept, but if you love spicy food, you might prefer going for their red gravy options.

🍞 Breads
We had Plain Roti, Garlic Naan, and Butter Naan — all fresh, soft and tasty.

🍹 Mocktails
• Virgin Mojito
• Watermelon Mojito
I’d rate the mocktails 7/10 — refreshing but can be improved slightly.

🍽 Quantity
One more major plus — the quantity is amazing! The portions are generous, and honestly, one dish is enough for two heavy eaters. Definitely value for money.

⭐ Service
The service was fantastic! The staff was attentive, quick, and made sure the spice levels were exactly how we wanted. Very swift service and extremely friendly staff.

Special mention to Joy and Devendra — they were wonderful and handled our orders perfectly. Honestly, the entire team deserves appreciation. Even though I couldn’t remember everyone’s name, they’ve truly hired excellent people to serve their customers.

🏡 Ambience & Facilities 🚗

The ambience is on another level — absolutely loved the concept! One of the best parts is the transparent glass kitchen, which lets you see how the food is being prepared. That openness adds a lot of trust and charm.

✔ Perfect cooling
✔ Big screen projector to watch matches — entertainment sorted!
✔ Cleanliness maintained throughout
✔ Comfortable seating
✔ Enough space for parties (can easily accommodate around 30–40 people)
✔ Ample parking space for 2-wheelers and 4-wheelers — even large enough to park 3 Volvo buses!

Overall, Akshit Restaurant delivers great food, amazing service, generous portions, and a beautiful ambience. Definitely worth visiting and highly recommended!
PS - They also do home delivery. 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Snehal Gawankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mood for some गावठी Dhaba food!
.
A few days ago I along with my bunch of loved ones decided to visit Aryan Agri Katta. It’s a dhaba which is located at NH 48. The place is simple but spacious. They also have hut style seating areas where a group of 10- 15 people can have their dinner.
.
We started by ordering some appetizers.
.
Masala Papad
A perfect munching option while you are deciding on the menu.
Crisp and delicious papad topped with onions, tomatoes, some spices and sev.
.
Chicken Lollipop
Being favourite and specially loved by kids we ordered chicken lollipop.
They were perfectly cooked, perfect crisp and immensely appetizing.
.
Chicken Tandoori
We had ordered 3 different types of tandoori: Normal, White & Schezwan.
All 3 were great and had its own taste but personally, I liked Schezwan tandoori.
.
They have a live chicken counter and for our dinner, we picked 2 live chicken from it. 1 was Gavthi Chicken & other was Kadaknath Chicken.
.
Gavthi Chicken
It’s always said that having Ghar ka khana is better than having restaurant food; same goes with chicken. Having gavthi chicken over broiler is always good.
The chicken curry was spicy and perfectly made by adding spices. The chicken was tender and tasted nice.
.
Kadaknath Chicken
It’s a chicken which is completely black and is known for its high iron content and much lower cholesterol than other breeds and sells at a much higher price than other varieties.
The chicken curry was spicy and perfectly made by adding spices. The chicken was tender and tasted nice. just superb. It was made in Agri style and I liked Kadaknath chicken curry over Gavthi chicken curry.
The chicken was cooked perfectly but at the same time I couldn’t eat the pieces more maybe because of its blackish-grey colour but I thoroughly enjoyed the gravy.
.
Roti/ Bhakri
To have this yummilicious gravy’s we decided to order Rotis.
The size of the roti was huge and they were super soft.
It really complimented well with the gravy.
.
I really had a great time and most importantly enjoyed my meal. The best thing about this dhaba was it gives you a feel of dhaba maybe because of their simple ambience and their home-styled spicy food.
I would definitely recommend visiting this place if you are passing by NH48 highway
.
.
